title_zh: 确认续借尚未办理及提醒安排

scenario.label_zh: 核对原还书期限并约定再次查询续借提醒
scenario.goal_zh: 确认原还书期限仍有效并约定次日上午提醒再次查询续借

context_zh: 图书馆读者 Enid 向馆员 Ravi 询问系统临时离线期间的续借。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Enid
sentences.text: Can I renew my book? The due date is Friday.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The renewal system is presently offline, so I can't confirm an extension.

sentences.speaker: Enid
sentences.text: Would it help if I tried again tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Yes. I can send a reminder tomorrow morning, but that won't change the due date by itself.

sentences.speaker: Enid
sentences.text: Please do. I'll keep Friday as the deadline unless a renewal is confirmed.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Understood. The reminder will ask you to check again, not say the book has been renewed.
